description:
NOV is seeking a motivated and detail oriented Product Engineer that has 3-5 years minimum experience in artificial lift industry, or more specifically, electric submersible pumps. In this role the ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, improving and supporting products from concept through production. This role involves collaborating with cross functional teams to ensure products meet customer requirements, reliability thresholds and product performance.

 Design, develop and enhance products based on customer and business requirements
 collaborate with product management, design, manufacturing and quality teams throughout the product lifecycle
 create and maintain engineering drawings, specifications and technical documentation
 create and edit Bill of Materials for variety of products
 conduct product testing, validation and performance analysis
 identify design improvements to enhance quality, reliability, manufacturability and cost efficiency
 support new product introduction and product launches
 Perform root cause analysis for product failures and recommend solutions
 Participate in design reviews, risk assessments and continuous improvement
 work with suppliers and manufacturing teams to resolve technical issues
 work individually or as part of a team and ability to multi-task
  
  

 
 Bachelors degree in mechanical Engineering or related technical field
 3-5 years of experience in product engineering, product development or a similar role
 Proficiency in CAD software such as solidworks
 Knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials and quality standards
 strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills
 Use of Basic hand tools including quality measuring devices
 2d drawing and understanding of GD&T
 Project Management and time management skills
